what: getPerfStats() in three populated settlements, same seed, same stands, same GPU model (RTX A4500), arms differing only in game/src/render/
gpu_after: ANGLE (NVIDIA, Vulkan 1.3.277 (NVIDIA NVIDIA RTX A4500 (0x00002232)), NVIDIA)
gpu_before: ANGLE (NVIDIA, Vulkan 1.4.303 (NVIDIA NVIDIA RTX A4500 (0x00002232)), NVIDIA)

rows.render_cpu_ms: REFUSED BY THE HARNESS. getPerfStats()._unmeasurable hard-codes "This container is SwiftShader" and returns renderCpuMs 0 — on a run whose own WebGL context reports an NVIDIA RTX A4500. The gate reads the container, not the renderer string, so a real hardware frame time cannot be obtained through this verb today. That is a round-3 fix in game/src/engine.js, not something this piece could work around.
